title: Simulated SRXN1(t) for Sulforaphane continuous exposure: measured NRF2 and SRXN1 time courses (HepG2)

model.equations: dSrxn1/dt = kp + Vmax*H(Nu;Km,n_u)*H(Nm;Km_act,n_m) - kd*Srxn1; Nu=NRF2*(1-f), Nm=NRF2*f; f(t)=1/((1/f_i-1)*exp(-t*r)+exp(t*decay))
model.integrator: RK4 dt=0.025 h; monotone cubic Hermite NRF2 input

fit.note: observed vs simulated (mean NRF2 input) SRXN1 at integer hours, pooled across all concentrations
